skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Automates Twitter/X posting, media posts, engagement actions, DMs, follows, and profile lookups through the inference.sh CLI.
skill.summary: Use inference.sh CLI apps to manage Twitter/X posting and engagement workflows.
skill.author: inference-sh-8

security_audit.summary: The skill is a Markdown wrapper for inference.sh Twitter/X automation, with most static command hits coming from fences, table entries, and CLI examples. The Quick Start contains a confirmed critical pipe-to-shell installer, and the remote image creates a low-severity external request. The skill also enables social engagement automation that could support spam or inauthentic outreach without safeguards.

remediation.suggestion: Replace it with a package-manager install or manual checksum-verified download. Do not recommend piping remote scripts directly to a shell.
Bundle a local image or remove the remote image to avoid automatic requests to cloud.inference.sh during rendering.

remediation.issue: Social engagement automation can be abused
remediation.suggestion: Add consent, rate-limit, and platform-policy guidance for DMs, follows, likes, retweets, deletes, and posts.
Require the agent to summarize every action and obtain user confirmation before making account changes.

content.value_statement: Manual Twitter/X posting and engagement can slow repeatable social workflows. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh CLI actions for posts, media, DMs, follows, and lookups.
actual_capabilities: Post text updates to Twitter/X through x/post-tweet.
Create media posts from a media URL through x/post-create.
Like, retweet, delete, and fetch posts by ID.
Send direct messages and follow users through inference.sh apps.
Retrieve Twitter/X user profiles by username.
Chain generated image or video URLs into a Twitter/X post workflow.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated inference.sh account.
Requires a configured Twitter/X integration with the needed permissions.
The skill does not show a built-in scheduler despite mentioning scheduling.
Actions remain subject to Twitter/X API limits and platform rules.

use_cases.title: Publish Product Updates
use_cases.description: Draft and post concise product announcements or release notes to Twitter/X after user approval.

use_cases.title: Manage Social Engagement
use_cases.description: Like, retweet, follow, or send direct messages for approved community interactions.

use_cases.title: Share Generated Media
use_cases.description: Create an image or video with inference.sh and publish the resulting media URL to Twitter/X.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Basic Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create and post a concise Twitter/X update about [topic]. Show me the final text and ask for confirmation before posting.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a Twitter/X post using [media URL]. Draft the text, check the URL, and ask before creating the post.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Engagement
prompt_templates.prompt: Like or retweet [tweet ID] only after summarizing the target post and asking me to confirm the action.

prompt_templates.title: Publish AI Media Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image or video with inference.sh, extract its media URL, draft a Twitter/X post, and request confirmation before publishing.

output_examples.input: Post a launch update for a new analytics dashboard.
output_examples.output: Drafted a short launch post, highlighted the dashboard benefit, and requested approval before posting to X.

output_examples.input: Create a post with a product image URL.
output_examples.output: Prepared a media post caption, verified the URL format, and identified the x/post-create action to use after approval.

output_examples.input: Retweet a customer testimonial by ID.
output_examples.output: Flagged this as a mutating engagement action and asked for confirmation before retweeting.

best_practices: Confirm every post, DM, follow, like, retweet, and delete before running the action.
Use verified installation steps for the inference.sh CLI before connecting accounts.
Respect Twitter/X platform rules, rate limits, and recipient consent.
anti_patterns: Sending bulk unsolicited DMs or following users without a clear consent basis.
Running remote install scripts through a shell without local inspection or checksum verification.
Publishing generated media without reviewing accuracy, rights, and disclosure needs.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to X?
faq.answer: It can guide inference.sh CLI app calls that post, like, retweet, DM, follow, delete, and fetch X data.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: You need the inference.sh CLI, an authenticated inference.sh account, and a configured Twitter/X integration.

faq.question: Can it schedule tweets?
faq.answer: The skill description mentions scheduling, but SKILL.md does not show a built-in scheduler.

faq.question: Does it upload media files?
faq.answer: The examples use media URLs with x/post-create. Local upload behavior is not documented in the skill.

faq.question: Is it safe for bulk engagement?
faq.answer: No. Bulk likes, retweets, DMs, or follows can violate platform rules and harm recipients.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
